name: logcadence
description: Read and tag the videos in Logcadence's YouTube tab, in the running app.
long_description: Talks to Logcadence running on this computer (its local API on 127.0.0.1). Lets Claude list the YouTube tab's videos and tags, read a video's notes, tag videos in batches and rename tags. Logcadence must be running.

tools.name: yt_list_tags
tools.description: Every tag path used in the YouTube tab, with video counts.

tools.name: yt_list_videos
tools.description: Videos, paged, filtered by untagged, tag or text.

tools.name: yt_get_video
tools.description: One video with the user's notes and kept comments.

tools.name: yt_set_tags
tools.description: Add or replace the tags of videos, in batches.

tools.name: yt_move_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag path on every video.
